old.Title: Mark attendance with valid employeeId and absent
old.Description: Verify marking attendance with valid employeeId and absent fields returns 200 and attendance data
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing valid employeeId and absent
Verify response status is 200
Verify response body contains attendance data with employeeId and absent
old.Expected Result: Response status is 200 and response body contains attendance data with employeeId 1 and absent false

old.Title: Mark batch attendance with valid payload
old.Description: Verify marking batch attendance with valid list of attendance records
old.Pre-Conditions: Attendance service and repository are available
Test Steps: Prepare a list of valid attendance DTOs with employeeId and absent fields
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as body
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response contains savedCount equal to number of valid records
Verify response contains presentCount and absentCount matching input data
Verify invalidEntries list is empty
old.Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount 2, presentCount 1, absentCount 1, invalidEntries empty

old.Description: Verify response when sending empty list as payload

Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with empty list as body
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'
old.Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'payload is empty'

old.Title: Mark batch attendance with some invalid entries
old.Description: Verify batch attendance marking when some entries have missing employeeId or absent
old.Pre-Conditions: Attendance service and repository are available
Test Steps: Prepare a list of attendance DTOs where some have null employeeId or absent
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as body
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response savedCount equals number of valid entries
Verify invalidEntries list contains employeeIds of invalid entries with employeeId
Verify presentCount and absentCount match valid entries
old.Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount 2, presentCount 1, absentCount 1, invalidEntries contains [3]

old.Title: Mark batch attendance with all invalid entries
